categories.label: Bug
categories.action: Fix the defect, add a focused test, then resolve the discussion.

categories.label: Security
categories.action: Prioritize remediation and request security review before resolving.

categories.label: Performance
categories.description: An inefficient implementation or scalability risk.
categories.action: Benchmark, optimize the bottleneck, and validate the impact.

categories.label: Correctness
categories.description: An edge case, logic error, or data-integrity issue.
categories.action: Correct the behavior and add coverage for the affected case.

categories.label: Maintainability
categories.description: A readability, structure, duplication, or technical-debt concern.
categories.action: Refactor when the agreed value justifies the change.

categories.label: Testing
categories.description: Missing, weak, or incorrect automated coverage.
categories.action: Add or repair focused automated tests.

categories.label: Documentation
categories.description: Missing or inaccurate documentation or code comments.
categories.action: Update the relevant documentation or explanatory comment.

categories.label: Style
categories.description: A formatting or low-risk convention issue.

categories.label: Question
categories.description: A request for clarification or an unresolved design decision.
categories.action: Answer the question or agree on a decision, then resolve it.

categories.label: Praise
categories.description: Positive feedback without a requested code change.
categories.action: Acknowledge the feedback; normally no code change is needed.

categories.label: Other
categories.description: Feedback that does not fit a defined category.
categories.action: Triage manually and agree on the appropriate next step.
